mechanics.title: Instamine (pack config)
mechanics.description: Netherite pickaxe instamines deepslate, cobblestone and end stone; netherite axe instamines logs (enable_logs_instamine true). Per the mod description it needs Efficiency V and Haste II; the pack sets speed_factor 1000. No other tools qualify in the pack config.

mechanics.title: Renewable deepslate
mechanics.description: Enabled below Y=11 (renewable_deepslate_below_level): lava/water generators produce deepslate (cobbled deepslate like cobblestone) and calcite (like basalt).

vanilla_changes.change: Instantly mined with a netherite pickaxe/axe at Efficiency V + Haste II.
Produce deepslate variants and calcite instead of the usual stone/basalt results.

getting_started: Enchant a netherite pickaxe with Efficiency V, stand in a Haste II beacon, and mine deepslate.
editor_notes: Config values come from config-overrides.json (deepslate_instamine.json). Needed on both client and server.
name: Deepslate Instamine
summary: A netherite pickaxe with Efficiency V under Haste II (beacon) mines deepslate instantly, and lava next to water can generate deepslate and calcite at low Y levels. Pack config also extends instamining to cobblestone, end stone and logs.
